findings.finding: The watcher pins the full HWND/class/control-ID/parent chain, but PathBinding.token sends only hwnd/home/caption/directory. Final AssertSliceSource checks ownership/descendant/caption/path without checking the pinned topology and IDs.
findings.evidence: Token fields are directory, home, home_caption, hwnd; chain is absent. This is a direct source/token finding, not a Windows execution claim.
findings.risk: A leaf reparented within the same Home, or a reused handle of a different field, can pass the final source guard after watcher validation.
findings.required_fix: Serialize and validate the complete pinned chain at both native checkpoints: exact first leaf, last selected root, PID/root membership, class, control ID, immediate parent and chain adjacency. Do not query arbitrary ancestor/grid WndProc.
findings.required_regression: Actual Windows guard rejects same-Home reparent and class/control-ID mismatch before edit; post-edit failure remains terminal ambiguity.

findings.reproduction: Publish folderA, refresh/queue new analysis, change001.bmp from0 to100percent ink while restoring size/mtime, then run that queued analysis.
findings.risk: A new same-path byte revision becomes ready without the promised BJT reload acknowledgment. Subsequent digest checks compare against the new dataset and cannot discover the missed transition.
findings.required_fix: Compare the new exact canonical path-to-SHA inventory against the last acknowledged same-directory byte version before ready. Do not advance acknowledged bytes automatically while reload is pending; config-only reanalysis with identical source bytes may remain ready.
findings.required_regression: Same-stat mutation during config refresh/analysis is detected before publication readiness and requires acknowledgment plus a fresh cutoff/barriers.

findings.status: Independently reproduced for UNKNOWN and missing actual IR; changes requested
findings.reproduction: After initial handoff completes, a mismatched-source row4 enters a new auto baseline wait without image_waiting. Row5 is valid baseline. New row6 arrives with UNKNOWN state or missing actual IR; then exactly the same cached row6 becomes ready.
findings.risk: The automatic baseline layer is cleared without can_calculate/finite-C eligibility; restoring readiness turns a held cached sample into a new calculation/Save.
findings.required_fix: Require full calculation readiness and finite actual settings before releasing the auto barrier. Consume valid source-consistent key/layer observations while unready, including cached different layers and same-layer rewrites. Require a future fresh different layer after readiness returns.
findings.required_regression: Both UNKNOWN and missing-C row6 cases must produce no calculation/Save on restored cached row6; only a future row7 may proceed.

findings.reproduction: Obtain admission at version1; advance heartbeat age beyond2seconds; admit returns false while ready remains true. poll_once refreshes heartbeat without invalidation, after which the identical old admission returns true at the same version.
findings.risk: A watcher gap during calculation can reject a write and then revive an old epoch/proposal without new analysis, cutoff or baseline.
findings.required_fix: Lease expiry must be a monotonic invalidation in frame, admit and watcher recovery before heartbeat refresh. Require a new publication/epoch and baseline; returning health must not revive prior admissions.
findings.required_regression: Expiry during calculation and heartbeat-first recovery both keep old admission permanently rejected and cannot resume from a cached observation.

findings.status: Independently reproduced at the learning boundary; changes requested
findings.reproduction: After baseline, change003.bmp from0 to100percent ink with identical metadata before row3. Controller recommends holding50, so apply is skipped.
findings.risk: Unverified stale image features enter Excel and observed blank-run history whenever no Save is needed. By a later real Save the changed layer may no longer be current/prior, so the final two-file guard cannot detect contaminated earlier state. A large-set round-robin background digest is not timely admission proof.
findings.required_fix: Obtain bounded read-only current/prior content and CSV-lineage proof before every image-dependent calculation/history promotion, including baseline and equal-power recommendations. Perform I/O outside the gate lock, then compare-and-commit version/epoch/lineage before promoting history. Keep final pre-edit/pre-Save proofs.
findings.required_regression: Same-stat mutation on a no-Save/held row must not enter Excel or known powder history. Test change during proof and superseded lineage, while watcher remains responsive.

findings.reproduction: A valid layer5 from jobA followed by layer6 from jobB reuses previous-valid1/powder1. Likewise, after layer5 is observed, a corrected layer5 from the wrong folder is rejected, but later layer6 still reuses its previous history.
findings.risk: Previous-image/blank-run provenance can be attributed to the wrong run or to a row whose later lineage was rejected.
findings.required_fix: Segment confirmed observed history by run and separate CSV file generation. Invalidate or quarantine corrected layer provenance; keep it unknown until a new consistent observation sequence. Preserve the ordinary CSV semantic key.
findings.required_regression: New run, same-path CSV rewrite/generation change and same-layer lineage correction cannot inherit old confirmed previous-image or powder-run history.
